title: carex glomerabilis

This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Carex glomerabilis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
